metadata.question: Did Dry Chaco forest cover decrease by more than 10% between 2000 and 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: MODIS vegetation continuous fields (VCF) for percent tree cover, or Landsat-based forest cover products. - The standard VCF product is MODIS/006/MOD44B, annual, 250 m, band “Percent_Tree_Cover”. - Date: 2000 and 2019 (two single-year images). - Location: Dry Chaco ecoregion – use a polygon covering the bulk of the Dry Chaco (approx. −22°, −60° centre, ~600 km box). 2. Masking strategy: - VCF has quality flags but no cloud mask; we simply clip to the Dry Chaco polygon. - Mask out water (VCF water mask band == 1) and any invalid pixels (percent tree cover <0 or >100). 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs Null/Error: - Load 2000 and 2019 images. - If either year’s image collection is empty → C1. - After masking, count valid pixels per year; if either year has 0 valid pixels → C2. - Compute mean tree cover % for 2000 and 2019; if any mean is None/NaN/out-of-range → C3. - Otherwise calculate relative change: (cover2019 – cover2000)/cover2000 * 100. - If relative decrease > –10 % (i.e. change ≤ –10 %) → A (Yes), else B (No). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry: approximate Dry Chaco bounding box dry_chaco = ee.Geometry.Polygon( [[-65, -20], [-57, -20], [-57, -26], [-65, -26]]) # 2. Data acquisition col2000 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD44B').filterDate('2000-01-01', '2000-12-31') col2019 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD44B').filterDate('2019-01-01', '2019-12-31') if col2000.size().getInfo() == 0 or col2019.size().getInfo() == 0: print("Empty collection for 2000 or 2019.") print("C1") img2000 = col2000.first().select('Percent_Tree_Cover') img2019 = col2019.first().select('Percent_Tree_Cover') # Mask water and invalid values def mask_vcf(img): water = img.select('Water_Mask').eq(0) tc = img.select('Percent_Tree_Cover') valid = tc.gt(0).And(tc.lte(100)) return tc.updateMask(water.And(valid)) tc2000 = mask_vcf(img2000) tc2019 = mask_vcf(img2019) # 3. Pixel counts count2000 = tc2000.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=dry_chaco, scale=250, maxPixels=1e9).get('Percent_Tree_Cover').getInfo() count2019 = tc2019.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=dry_chaco, scale=250, maxPixels=1e9).get('Percent_Tree_Cover').getInfo() if count2000 == 0 or count2019 == 0: print("No valid pixels after masking.") print("C2") # 4. Mean tree cover mean2000 = tc2000.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=dry_chaco, scale=250, maxPixels=1e9).get('Percent_Tree_Cover').getInfo() mean2019 = tc2019.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=dry_chaco, scale=250, maxPixels=1e9).get('Percent_Tree_Cover').getInfo() if mean2000 is None or mean2019 is None: print("Calculation failed.") print("C3") change_pct = (mean2019 - mean2000) / mean2000 * 100 print(f"2000 cover: {mean2000:.1f}%, 2019: {mean2019:.1f}%, change: {change_pct:.1f}%") # 5. Answer if change_pct <= -10: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry: approximate Dry Chaco bounding box
dry_chaco = ee.Geometry.Polygon(
    [[-65, -20], [-57, -20], [-57, -26], [-65, -26]])

# 2. Data acquisition
col2000 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD44B').filterDate('2000-01-01', '2000-12-31')
col2019 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD44B').filterDate('2019-01-01', '2019-12-31')

if col2000.size().getInfo() == 0 or col2019.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("Empty collection for 2000 or 2019.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

img2000 = col2000.first().select('Percent_Tree_Cover')
img2019 = col2019.first().select('Percent_Tree_Cover')

# Mask water and invalid values
def mask_vcf(img):
    water = img.select('Water_Mask').eq(0)
    tc = img.select('Percent_Tree_Cover')
    valid = tc.gt(0).And(tc.lte(100))
    return tc.updateMask(water.And(valid))

tc2000 = mask_vcf(img2000)
tc2019 = mask_vcf(img2019)

# 3. Pixel counts
count2000 = tc2000.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=dry_chaco, scale=250, maxPixels=1e9).get('Percent_Tree_Cover').getInfo()
count2019 = tc2019.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=dry_chaco, scale=250, maxPixels=1e9).get('Percent_Tree_Cover').getInfo()
if count2000 == 0 or count2019 == 0:
    print("No valid pixels after masking.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")

# 4. Mean tree cover
mean2000 = tc2000.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=dry_chaco, scale=250, maxPixels=1e9).get('Percent_Tree_Cover').getInfo()
mean2019 = tc2019.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=dry_chaco, scale=250, maxPixels=1e9).get('Percent_Tree_Cover').getInfo()

if mean2000 is None or mean2019 is None:
    print("Calculation failed.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")

change_pct = (mean2019 - mean2000) / mean2000 * 100
print(f"2000 cover: {mean2000:.1f}%, 2019: {mean2019:.1f}%, change: {change_pct:.1f}%")

# 5. Answer
if change_pct <= -10:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
